book.name: 1 Jön
book.title: 1 Jön Jöntho bapiya ngo Duichon owi amnaniha irim togoc

content: Duic yu woi tongfatnec noni sinom

Nakain managumbocnai, nocho mata ngo sontha irim tatma wömai ‘son wömuno toninga’ yongo tat. Wohong amna auho wömuno tontacmai wömai woroc, tongfatnec noni itac. Yu woi amna nongnongo ino yabitno Yesu Duic woroc. Yu wömai Kopotorocot itmuna mata youpdec tongfat nengitac.

Yu worocho inoin godip föbo ‘nontha’ yongo bogingga Kopotorochon irotno tun fökogoc. Tongo yuho turongo noni fuun detdup togoc. O wo togocma woi nonthon turongo nonihagon matogoc, muno woi owi amna guroc danong idangma yu ambarac tongfat yecyecha wömai togoc.
Kopotorochon nongoru wego
Oro, nontho Kopotorochon nongoru mata sumbot tongontamonanu wömai non boinno sinom kombiamon, irot noniho yu kombicno sinom tac.

Oro amna auho ingoroc yun: “Noc Kopotoroc kombing impat.” Oro yu ihoroc yontac mahong yu Kopotorochon nongoru mataricanu wömai woroc, amna woi imanang amna entac. Tongo Kopotorochon mata boinnoho yuhon irodinu maic.

Wohong amna auho yuhon nongoru matano sumbentacma wömai woroc, Kopotorocho yu irot imogocma kiapmo worocho irotnon dogo kungga mac fiuna ino yabitno entac. Kiap ihorocnoha wömai nonu kombiantamon, boinno sinom, non Kopotorochon owi amna idamon yo.
Oro amna au ingoroc yun: “Nocu Kopotorochon amna sinom itat yo.” Ihoroc yonggai wömai yu muyu Yesuho itongidocma worochon torocgon itongoun.
Oröc ori, nocho nongoru mata fodibo makanot. Muno, nocho nongoru kantatma woi osucgon soniot itdegoc. Woi yongburoc mata son forosicsicnodec kombigungma woroc.

Wohong boinno woi, nongoru ngo woi ihorocgon nongoru wego. Nontho Duichon itonggong kiap orin sonthon itonggong kiap soni yangmanaina ingoroc kombiantamon: Nongoru wego wo woi boinno. Wömai yaha, kumbongu urop bödec bödecha tac. O yaguno boinno wo urop yaguno möngdengga itac.
Oro amna auho ingoroc yun: “Noc yagunodec itat yo.” Yu ihoroc yontac mahong yu orugo ayam tong imontacanu wömai woroc, yu abe kumbongnodec itac.
Amna au orugoha toup kombingitacma yu wömai yagunodec itac. O yagunodec wömai yapmu au amna dou möcmöchon toroc maec.
Wohong amna au orugo ayam tong impacma yu wömai kumbongnodec itac. Tuna kumbongo daro tun kumbong diuna yu uyap yaönoma sindanto ongeyacno wo makombic. Muno, yui kumbongnodecgon itongontac.
Nakain managumbocnai sinom, Duichon madec Kopotorocho turongo soni imun fadoc. Worocha noc bapiya ngo ‘sontha’ yongo irim tat.

Son nandöng, son amna forosicsicnodec idocmaho önga itacma yu kombingdeang. Worocha noc bapiya ngo ‘sontha’ yongo irim tat. Son amna berac, son urop dogu kopot anggirat bödegung. Worocha noc bapiya ngo ‘sontha’ yongo irim tat. Nakain managumbocnai sinom, son Nandöng kombicno sinom tang. Worocha noc bapiya ngo ‘sontha’ yongo irim tat.

Son nandöng, son amna foro sicsicnodec idocmaho önga itacma yu kombingdeang. Worocha noc bapiya ngo ‘sontha’ yongo irim tat. Son amna berac, son koing socsoc itkampac. Tongo Kopotorochon mataho irot sonidec itac. Tuna son urop dogu kopot anggirat bödegung. Worocha noc bapiya ngo ‘sontha’ yongo irim tat.
Non irot noni gurochon manomanodec ding fing akep tonintha
Son gurochon toroc kiapa orin gurochon ibibo manomano wo kombingitninga. Amna au yu irotno gurochon manomanodec ding fing akep tontacma yudec wömai Nandönghon irot imocimoc kiapu maic.

Wömai yaha, guroc amnahon toroc kiap wömuno woi ambarac Nandöngdecma muno, woi gurochon fatgon idang. Noc kiap ingorocnoha yat: Turongo toctoc amnahon ibibo wömuno, o dantho yang irup öcöc kiap, o inoin yoctec manomanoha orin inoin youpha tongga inoin ma töc töc kiap.
Guroc ngo orin yuhon ibibo ambarac woi bisong ongbödenahing mahong amna yu Kopotorochon irot kombic kombic tanitacma, yu wömai iditnoho iditno engoc.
Duichon ayamo yu urop öngkuboc

Nakain managumbocnai sinom, bongono madango urop engkupac. Son mata ngo urop kombigung: Duichon ayamo yu ehangoc. O boinno önga urop Duichon ayami koböc öngkung-bödeang. Worocha nonu kombiamon, bongono madango urop engkupac.

Duichon ayami yu osuc Duichon suraro nonot kondong ididung mahong yui nonthon torop sinom maidung. Worocha yu non dongyu fadung. Yu nonthon torop sinom idahai wömai yu nonot iditno ip. Wohong yu non dongyu fadungma wömai ingoroc nindahac, yui ambarac nonthon toropdecma muno.
Worochoi oro, son wömai Duicho guram sing kamuna Kunkun Yaru sonidec itdehac. Worocha tongga son ambarac mata boinnohon foro kombingbödeang.
Nocho bapiya ngo son mata boinnohon foro makombingmaha irim matot. Muno, noc irim tatma woi son mata boinno urop kombingbödeangmaha tat. Mata boinnoho wömai mata imanang tungu au matun öngkuic.

Muno sinom, imanang amna woi numa? Woi amna ingoroc yongitacma, ‘Yesuho non itonggong koing matun öngkung nimic yo’. Oro amna ihorocno wömai imanang amna orin Duichon ayamo itac. Yu wömai Nandöng Kopotoroc orin Manano yu yait yait me imogoc.
Amna auho Mananoha me imontacma, yu wömai Nandöng Kopotorocot irot tungu maec. Wohong amna auho Mananoha kombing tobing imontacma, yu wömai Nandöng Kopo-torocot irot tungu itac.
Kunkun Yaru yu mata boinnohon foro fandat ninongitac

Oro, son kombic kombicho itongmuya fatmata ogepma osuc kombigungma worocgon kokoreuya irot sonin itun. Worocho sonot idinai wömai son ihorocgon Manano orin Nandöng Kopotoroc yuot kondong idtongonahing.
Idit koingha wömai Duicho ‘son wo sogit-nahing’ yongo mata godingmun fadoc.
Oro, amna auho wömai son gorong onggongon uyapdec kangat fonggonga kombiang. Worocha tongga nocho sontha garac mata ngo irim tat.

Wohong Duic yu guramno sing kamuna Kunkun Yaruho son madongyun fatning. Muno, yu wömai sonot itmuna son manomano ambaracha fandat kanongitac. Kunkun Yaruhon matano woi boinno, imanang muno. Worocha wömai woroc, son onggim soni fandat fandat amna boyömoha sininga. Muno son muyu Kunkun Yaruhon matano sindanda kombing tobic tobic soni Duicdec singmuya itongitnung.
Non Kopotorochon weni manani idamon

Nakain managumbocnai, son Duic imu faicha. Muno, son yuot kondonggon itong tongitnung. Son ihoroc tonahinganu wömai woroc, yuho wönggon ehangocan bongono wocin sonu tong bumbum soni muno yuho yangamin iditha yangam fapfapu matoning.

Son urop kombiang, Duic yu toroc kiap nong nongodecgon itongidoc. Worocha wömai son ihorocgon kombiang, owi amna ambaracho toroc kiap nongnongodec itongidangma yui ambaracho Kopotorochon weni manani öngkungbödegung.
